updates.title: Microsoft Purview Network Data Security Now Generally Available
updates.summary: Data Loss Prevention now integrates Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to protect sensitive data at the network layer across browsers, apps, APIs, and AI platforms, preventing data leakage to untrusted cloud applications. This extends DLP enforcement beyond traditional Microsoft 365 endpoints to include generative AI and third-party SaaS services.

updates.title: Multiple Azure and Microsoft Identity Services Elevation of Privilege Vulnerabilities Patched
updates.summary: Microsoft patched six critical elevation of privilege vulnerabilities affecting Microsoft Dataverse (CVE-2026-77903), Azure AI Foundry (CVE-2026-85889), Microsoft Fabric (CVE-2026-69843), Microsoft Container Registry (CVE-2026-69865), Azure Database for PostgreSQL (CVE-2026-85878), and Azure Machine Learning (CVE-2026-68791), all exploitable over the network. Admins should prioritize patching these services to prevent unauthorized privilege escalation and authentication bypasses.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Integrates with Entra Conditional Access in Edge for Business
updates.summary: Purview DLP for Microsoft Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business now integrates directly with Conditional Access grant controls, expanding policy conditions, supporting multiple activities per rule, and providing visibility in Activity Explorer. This simplification enables richer data protection policies without the previous Purview restrictions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Expands DLP Protection for Unmanaged AI Apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP policies now protect a significantly broader set of unmanaged generative AI and SaaS applications through Edge for Business inline protection, using existing Purview classifiers and sensitivity labels. This allows admins to extend consistent data security controls to more third-party destinations without complex policy recreation.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Auto-Labeling Policy Coverage Report
updates.summary: Admins can now view per-policy coverage reports showing which files were labeled versus not yet labeled during auto-labeling enforcement, compared against the latest simulation run. This visibility helps admins track enforcement progress and identify files processed but not captured in the simulation snapshot.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Unified Classification Management Experience
updates.summary: Purview introduces a unified interface for managing all classifiers—Sensitive Information Types, Exact Data Match, fingerprint SITs, and trainable classifiers—in one place for discovery, creation, validation, and administration. This consolidation simplifies classifier governance and reduces fragmentation across the compliance platform.

updates.title: Endpoint DLP Pre-Curated File Extension List
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now provides a pre-curated list of supported file extensions for policy conditions instead of free-form text entry, reducing misconfiguration and preventing unsupported extensions from being scanned. This improves policy reliability and reduces unnecessary endpoint processing overhead.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Retention Policies Support SharePoint File Archiving
updates.summary: Admins can now configure retention policies to archive inactive SharePoint files to low-cost storage, complementing existing keep and delete actions within Data Lifecycle Management. This enables comprehensive content lifecycle governance while reducing storage costs and keeping archived data discoverable.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management Reduces Temporary File Noise
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management receives enhanced filtering to reduce false-positive signals from OS and application temporary files (created by Windows, Office, browsers), which currently generate high-volume low-signal Endpoint activity events. Improved temporary file pattern detection will allow admins to focus on genuine security signals without over-excluding legitimate activity.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management Auto-Deletion for Departed Employees
updates.summary: Admins can now automatically delete both content and containers (OneDrives and mailboxes) for departed users at scale through Data Lifecycle Management policies. This eliminates manual cleanup overhead and ensures tenant compliance without ongoing administrative effort.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery In-Product Diagnostics
updates.summary: eDiscovery now includes self-service diagnostics that identify common configuration issues with case permissions, security filters, and policy status, providing guidance to resolve them. This built-in troubleshooting capability helps admins overcome obstacles without external support.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Sensitive Data Insights and Policy Recommendations
updates.summary: Purview now provides insights on sensitive data in OneDrive and SharePoint with retention policy recommendations to help admins improve their data security and compliance posture. This guidance-driven approach helps organizations make informed decisions about sensitive data governance.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Integrates with Island Enterprise Browser
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now integrates with Island Enterprise Browser to detect and protect sensitive data shared through unmanaged cloud apps in browser workflows, using the same Purview classifiers and sensitivity labels. This extends DLP protection to browser-based SaaS interactions that were previously difficult to monitor.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Teams Retention Policies Scope Change for Copilot
updates.summary: Legacy retention policies scoped to Microsoft Teams will be converted to Teams-only policies and will no longer implicitly govern Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions. Admins should review existing policies to ensure Copilot retention requirements are explicitly configured if needed.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Extends to Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Data Loss Prevention policies now protect sensitive data at rest in non-Microsoft applications like Box and Google Workspace using existing Defender for Cloud Apps connectors and Purview classifiers. This enables consistent DLP enforcement across hybrid environments without recreating policies for each platform.
